Target character: Christian Mensah.

At Scenario 2, Christian knows that Jonathan is in trouble but does not yet know the nature of it. Jonathan says the situation is complicated and that he needs support and resources. Christian’s intention is to help Jonathan, offer support, and face the problem together.

At Scenario 3, Christian now believes Jonathan’s trouble may be related to criminal activity. He asks Jonathan about illegal involvement. Jonathan says he may have gotten involved with the wrong people but denies doing anything illegal himself. At this point, Christian still does not know that Jonathan is being framed, nor who the real culprit is; those facts become known later in Scenarios 4 and 5. Christian decides to investigate discreetly rather than simply offering direct help/support.

So yes, Christian’s intention changes from intending to help Jonathan to intending to investigate discreetly.

ANSWER: a
